name: Test Framework - C#
body:
Nuget.org - StoicDreams.TestFramework

A helper framework that keeps tests strictly to an Arrange / Act / Assert structure.

Includes the `Moq` and `FluentAssertion` libraries for mocking data and writing readable tests.

name: Test Framework - C# Blazor
body: An extended version of StoicDreams.TestFramework that adds methods for testing .razor / Blazor components.
